fig01_moment_fibres.description: Exact moment identities; probability-simplex projection loses phase information.
fig01_moment_fibres.review_scope: Figure inspected visually and checked against its final manuscript caption.

fig02_cubic_witness.description: Left: exact cubic witness on a projective line. Right: seeded illustration of the proved distance bound, not its proof.
fig02_cubic_witness.review_scope: Figure inspected visually and checked against its final manuscript caption.

fig03_tensor_balance.description: Exact support of the three-qutrit Cartan tensor; color magnitudes are illustrative coefficients a=1,b=.65,c=.35. Scalar marginal identity is exact for arbitrary complex a,b,c.
fig03_tensor_balance.review_scope: Figure inspected visually and checked against its final manuscript caption.

fig04_jet_geometry.description: Exact monomial jet cost on the degree-24 simplex; projective-dimension threshold formula with harmonic numbers.
fig04_jet_geometry.review_scope: Figure inspected visually and checked against its final manuscript caption.

fig05_singer_cover.description: Left is an abstract display of the ten labelled rays, not a Euclidean embedding of their projective incidence. Middle gives the exact cover construction. Right draws the shape of the Eisenstein lattice; its scale is fixed by Gram matrix [[14,-7],[-7,14]].
fig05_singer_cover.review_scope: Figure inspected visually and checked against its final manuscript caption.

fig06_gram_trees.description: Exact finite partition enumeration with integer directed-tree cofactors; no sampled spectral data.
fig06_gram_trees.review_scope: Figure inspected visually and checked against its final manuscript caption.

fig07_ordered_heaps.description: Exact order-polynomial/Bernoulli coefficients and the singularity radius 2 sin(pi/m) of the root-linear logarithmic response.
fig07_ordered_heaps.review_scope: Figure inspected visually and checked against its final manuscript caption.

fig08_modular_clocks.description: Exact normalized power-response filters and Fourier densities. Right compares exact scalar errors with the proved R^-1 and R^-3 local-commutator upper bounds.
fig08_modular_clocks.review_scope: Figure inspected visually and checked against its final manuscript caption.

fig09_quantum_networks.description: Schematic core-wire architecture, exact two-port bound, and its homogeneous-degree coarse-gap consequence. Values below zero are displayed as zero (no positive certificate), not as a claim of a zero physical gap.
fig09_quantum_networks.review_scope: Figure inspected visually and checked against its final manuscript caption.

fig10_measurement_cells.description: Exact Haar probability-simplex cells and their qutrit operator moments. Each output effect has eigenvalues 11/18,7/36,7/36.
fig10_measurement_cells.review_scope: Figure inspected visually and checked against its final manuscript caption.

fig11_multipoles.description: Exact spherical-harmonic restrictions n_z and (3 n_z^2-1)/2 on the unit disk. The spin-one degree/body diagram is truncated at degree4; each active site contributes degree1 or2. Time reversal removes odd total degree, not odd body level.
fig11_multipoles.review_scope: Figure inspected visually and checked against its final manuscript caption.

fig12_information_clocks.description: Exact Bessel score family, beta mixture of operator means, and positive one-node Gaussian/Radau approximants. Shaded scalar spectral-multiplier bracket induces fixed-state information-matrix order, not CP-map order.
fig12_information_clocks.review_scope: Figure inspected visually and checked against its final manuscript caption.

fig13_toric_transport.description: Exact finite assignment geometry for degree6 on CP2, deterministic rational squared-modulus points p=(alpha+1)/9, and the analytical angular-mean interval width log(N)/k+log(N!)/(kN). This concerns the angular mean, not each phase configuration or an attractive exponential moment.

data.assignment: identity, certified by the monotonicity of log(alpha+1)

fig13_toric_transport.review_scope: Figure inspected visually and checked against its final manuscript caption.
